_comment: Per boat-type specs. Sources: official Sailaway boat-design pages on sailaway.world
(the same boats carried over to Sailaway III), matched to btp numbers by hull mesh
size and game-code features. Boats 4 and 5 are not listed there; they use the
closest real boats on sailboatdata.com. Units: metres, tonnes, m^2.
areaUp = upwind sail area (main + largest jib), areaMax = with downwind sails.
polarFiles = bundled GPL polars from similar real boats: [file, weight, froude]
(blend weight; optional LWL ratio for Froude scaling). See polars/README.md.
To use a real polar instead of the generated one, add "polar": {"tws": [m/s...],
"speeds": [[19 speeds in m/s for twa 0,10..180] per tws]}.

4.name: 52' Cruising Catamaran
4.source: polar: Lagoon 380/560 blended by length; sailboatdata.com Lagoon 52 (LOA 15.85, 26038 kg, main 107 + jib 59 m^2); LWL estimated

5.name: 50' Performance Cruiser
5.source: sailboatdata.com X-50 (LWL 43.1 ft, 27337 lb, SA 1342 ft^2) as nearest performance-cruiser match

6.name: Nordic Folkboat
6.source: sailaway.world bdsnr 361; polar: median of 10 Nordic Folkboat ORC certificates

7.name: Marieholm IF Folkboat
7.source: assumed: the game's second Folkboat hull (same mesh size as 6); specs and polar: median of 11 Marieholm IF ORC certificates
